question: Five of the six records in this unit carry the retention text 'not applicable: a live tunnel, not stored bytes' (and a per_object_cap text 'not applicable: a tunnel or an address, not an object') although none is a tunnel: egress/google-cloud-free-trial and egress/google-cloud-free-tier are VMs, egress/google-cloud-run and egress/heroku are PaaS, egress/guildbit runs a Mumble server. Should a reconcile unit re-derive retention and per_object_cap for the whole egress topic?
why: egress/guildbit retention.stated was corrected from the vendor's how-it-works page (1 to 4 hours, extendable 3 times); the other four copies state 'not applicable: a live tunnel' for offers that are not tunnels and each needs its own first-party page and a decision
